text: {"features":[{"name":"Role-specific alignment","description":"How clearly the letter explains why this exact Information Security Engineering role at Google fits the applicant's background and goals.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter expresses generic interest in software or security work with little sign that it was tailored to this role."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter names the role and shows interest, but the connection to this team's actual work remains broad or formulaic."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter connects the applicant to one or two job themes such as security tooling, backend systems, or automation, but not in a sustained way."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows clear fit to several core responsibilities or mission elements and explains why those are attractive."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter feels unmistakably tailored to this role by tying past work and future goals directly to the team's stated mandate and context at Google."}]},{"name":"Security enablement mindset","description":"How strongly the letter frames security as helping developers through better defaults, automation, and lifecycle integration.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter treats security only as a topic area or prestige domain and does not show an enablement philosophy."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter suggests interest in preventing issues, but not how security should fit into developer workflows."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter mentions ideas like secure defaults, reducing toil, or embedding security, but only briefly."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter clearly frames security as helping developers through automation, guardrails, or lifecycle integration."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter makes scalable developer enablement the central security philosophy and links multiple past examples to that approach."}]},{"name":"Platform leverage orientation","description":"How much the letter shows motivation for foundational systems whose benefits compound across many teams or products.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter does not mention foundational leverage or broad downstream impact."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter expresses generic interest in impact or infrastructure without explaining compounding effects."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter notes that internal or core systems reach many teams, but only in passing."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter clearly values work whose benefits propagate across an organization or product portfolio."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter makes organization-wide leverage a central motivation and explains why foundational security systems are especially compelling."}]},{"name":"Academic preparation","description":"The strength of the applicant's formal academic qualification as presented in the letter.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The highest formal qualification presented is a bachelor's degree in a relevant field."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter presents a bachelor's degree plus some additional formal technical training short of a master's degree."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter presents a master's degree in a directly relevant field."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter presents a doctoral degree in a directly relevant field."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter presents doctoral-level preparation or equivalent advanced research training as clearly relevant to the technical depth of the role."}]},{"name":"Software product experience depth","description":"How much sustained hands-on experience the letter shows in testing, maintaining, and launching production software.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter shows only the bare minimum of production experience, with short tenure, narrow scope, or few launches."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter shows qualifying production work but limited breadth across the product lifecycle or services."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows solid multi-year experience testing, maintaining, and launching production software."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows substantial lifecycle ownership across several production services."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows extensive and convincing production experience across multiple services and years, making immediate readiness clear."}]},{"name":"Go engineering depth","description":"How strongly the letter demonstrates relevant experience building backend systems in Go.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter mentions Go without showing meaningful depth."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter shows some professional Go use but not clear primary ownership."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows regular production use of Go in backend or service work."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter presents Go as a primary language tied to meaningful service ownership or backend design."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows deep, directly relevant Go expertise through primary ownership of production backend systems and concrete architectural examples."}]},{"name":"Python engineering depth","description":"How much the letter demonstrates substantive Python experience relevant to automation, tooling, or services.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter does not mention Python."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions Python only lightly or as incidental scripting."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows practical Python use for tooling, prototypes, or internal services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows strong Python ownership across production automation or services used by others."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows production-grade Python engineering through robust services, tooling, or agent implementations that teams clearly rely on."}]},{"name":"Applied AI maturity","description":"How well the letter demonstrates relevant experience applying AI systems in production with attention to reliability.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter does not mention AI."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions AI or language models generically with no production detail."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows direct experience shipping AI-backed or LLM-backed functionality."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows production AI work plus explicit attention to evaluation, trustworthiness, hardening, or failure modes."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows strong applied AI maturity by pairing shipped AI systems with clear operational judgment about reliability limits and safeguards."}]},{"name":"Agentic systems design","description":"How strongly the letter demonstrates experience designing systems that coordinate autonomous agents with constrained infrastructure.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter does not mention agentic systems or autonomous tooling."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions agents but gives little sense of architecture or control."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter describes building agentic tooling at a high level."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter describes a clear architecture where agents act within constraints enforced by surrounding services."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows end-to-end ownership of agentic systems with explicit contracts, guardrails, auditability, or bounded autonomy."}]},{"name":"Vulnerability workflow automation","description":"How much the letter shows direct experience automating vulnerability intake, triage, or handling.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter does not mention vulnerability handling automation."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter talks about reducing security toil in the abstract but gives no direct example."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter states that the applicant automated vulnerability handling or triage at a general level."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter describes a concrete triage or handling automation that reduced manual work."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows strong ownership of a vulnerability pipeline with concrete elements such as classification, deduplication, routing, prioritization, or measured time savings."}]},{"name":"Security assessment depth","description":"How strongly the letter demonstrates hands-on practice performing security assessments on real systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter does not mention performing security assessments."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions security reviews or assessments vaguely, without method or scope."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter clearly states experience assessing the security of services or designs."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter specifies concrete assessment practices such as threat modeling, code review, attack-surface analysis, or remediation verification."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter presents security assessment as substantive engineering work with multiple concrete methods and clear evidence of finding, validating, or driving fixes."}]},{"name":"Algorithmic sophistication","description":"How well the letter demonstrates command of data structures and algorithms through concrete engineering examples.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter does not mention data structures or algorithms."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions algorithmic strength only as a claim."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter gives one concrete example of using data structures or algorithms to improve a system."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows strong algorithmic thinking through a specific redesign of a performance-critical or structurally messy problem."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter demonstrates unusually convincing algorithmic sophistication through technically credible examples of replacing weak heuristics or brute-force approaches with materially better structures or algorithms."}]},{"name":"Independent security development","description":"How much the letter shows security skill-building beyond normal job duties through certifications, competitions, or similar outside practice.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives no evidence of security learning beyond normal job duties."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter shows one modest external signal such as a basic certification or casual competition participation."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows recurring outside security practice or one clearly meaningful credential."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows substantial independent security development through OSCP-level credentialing or strong competitive results."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows exceptional independent security development through both high-rigor credentialing and serious ongoing competitive or external practice."}]},{"name":"Technical initiative beyond core job","description":"How strongly the letter demonstrates self-directed engineering through meaningful side projects, open-source maintenance, or upstream contributions.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter gives no evidence of self-directed technical work outside routine employment."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter mentions a small personal tool or light side project with limited technical scope."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows a credible side project, open-source contribution, or maintenance activity beyond the day job."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter shows substantial initiative through active open-source stewardship, upstream fixes, or a technically demanding side system."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter shows outstanding self-directed engineering through sustained ownership of technically complex outside work with real users, releases, or nontrivial systems challenges."}]},{"name":"Reliability-minded engineering","description":"How strongly the letter signals habits of building careful, maintainable, and trustworthy systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter provides little sign of attention to maintainability, correctness, or guardrails."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter makes generic claims about quality or seriousness but without concrete practices."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter shows some concern for dependable systems through themes like maintainability, quiet reliability, or careful boundaries."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter gives multiple concrete signals of rigor such as typed and tested code, guardrails, failure recovery, careful releases, or explicit trust constraints."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter makes engineering rigor a defining theme and backs it with concrete examples of building especially trustworthy systems for high-stakes or security-sensitive use."}]},{"name":"Specificity of evidence","description":"How much the letter backs its claims with concrete examples, context, and outcomes rather than generic assertions.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter relies mostly on broad claims with minimal supporting detail."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter includes a few concrete details but leaves many claims generic."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter supports several claims with specific projects, systems, or responsibilities."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter regularly grounds claims in concrete role-relevant examples or outcomes."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter makes nearly every important claim concrete, giving the overall case exceptional credibility."}]},{"name":"Organization and narrative coherence","description":"How clearly the letter is structured and how smoothly its points build into a persuasive overall case.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter feels disjointed, list-like, or hard to follow as a case for candidacy."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter has a basic structure but reads as loosely connected points rather than a unified argument."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter is generally organized and easy to follow."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter builds a clear, coherent case in which motivation and evidence reinforce each other."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter delivers an especially strong narrative or argument with smooth progression and a memorable through-line."}]},{"name":"Writing mechanics and polish","description":"How free the letter is from typos, spelling errors, awkward wording, and other surface issues that reduce professionalism.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"The letter contains frequent errors or awkward phrasing that noticeably distract from the application."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"The letter contains multiple visible errors or rough constructions that weaken professionalism."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"The letter contains some errors or awkward spots but remains professionally readable overall."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"The letter is clean and polished aside from minor occasional slips."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"The letter is mechanically strong throughout, with virtually no distracting errors and consistently professional phrasing."}]}]}
